cases.evidence: The two dear adjectives are separate source spans in an emphatic vocative addressed to Elizabeth, without a phantom person called Dear.

Original From thence is a PREP+ADV source adjunct, not a fabricated PP; the complete clause we proceeded to Oxford is independently parsed and linked as source of motion. A separate grammatical From there control passes and an omitted-subject near-miss does not use this construction.
O is an apostrophe marker, not a name or agent. Sleep is what is addressed and blessed is its adjectival epithet.

Had is overt finite perfect auxiliary, my eyes is a nested possessive plural NP built from lexical eye/plural instead of the misleading singular homograph, deceived is a past participle selecting accusative me. Perfect aspect, agent, patient and possession relations are source-verified, including an independent his/him control.

This professor is the independently proven demonstrative NP subject; singular was governs ADJP headed by unlike, with very as local degree modifier and his colleague as the comparison standard. Independent teacher/her-colleague and failed-agreement controls establish selection.

Source But success SHALL crown my endeavours selects coord_clause with success subject, finite modal SHALL, lexical crown base, endeavours NP with my possessor, and semantic AGENT(crown,success), MODALITY(crown,SHALL), AFFECTED(crown,endeavours). Independent But victory SHALL crown my efforts positive, ungrammatical modal + crowns near-miss negative, source/selected graph assertions, CI 44183471999.
Would and not operate over an explicitly unresolved predicate with subject You. If you saw him is its condition, with its own overt subject and object.

The exact source letter subscription is a nonfinite documentary NP followed by the independently proven two-part proper-name signatory; both real quotation delimiters and the comma are retained, with no fabricated finite clause. A matched nonmatching source and independent signatory were checked.
The walk has I as its subject and quick pace as manner. The second finite event has we as its subject, my college as its destination and soon as its temporal modifier.

Source-preserved quotation encloses a dateline with overt named location, calendar month, source-attested ordinal and an incomplete year 17--; the graph records the missing year digits as unknown, never manufactures a date. Independent Oxford 13th and completed-year negative controls pass.

The overt colon separates the infinitival resolution from a separate imperative Come with me, which has a genuine vocative Henry and purpose to order the horses. Goal, discourse plan, vocative, purpose and object graph relations are tested; a semicolon contrast is rejected.

The storm is agent of hung, exactly north of the town is its direct locative, and the later over-the-part phrase bears the independently identified relative which lies between... attached to the part. Tested with a separate proper-place control and an invalid who-for-which contrast.
Initial Then establishes the temporal sequence of spoke, which continues to have he as agent. It no longer creates a topic.
Ready is the adjectival content of the exclamation and the squire is the overt reporter. No unstated subject is fabricated for the adjective.
On deck is the destination of ran in context. The overt plural subject We stays the agent and deck is not left disconnected.

So with the second is licensed as conventional anaphoric minor predication with overt so ADV, full with-the-second PP and source stop; the tree deliberately does not invent an unspoken finite verb. The third is a positive independent control, without is an unsuitable contrast.
Clean modifies sand, and the bottom is the predicand of the nominal property sand rather than a volitional agent.

Original double dash signals abandoned quoted content rather than an invented predicate. The overt I thought...Dr. Livesey spans the interrupted content, while I began is an independently proven external reporting clause. Abbreviation, honorific, selected reporter relation, exact punctuation and an em-dash contrast are checked.
Fifth orders trip, quite grades different, and any of the others is the partitive comparison standard. Trip is the predicand of the copula.
Prophetic is the adjectival reported content. The doctor controls both said and touching. Picture and finger are respectively the participle's object and instrument, with his retained.

The preposed In the meantime is a temporal PP; I had a better chance independently supplies the matrix clause; as I supposed is a bounded epistemic incise between two real commas; before me is separately parsed as the final location, not a locative of supposed. Both independent pronoun and punctuation controls are tested.
Good is an acknowledgment. The resumed speech is a permission question whose action is go, with temporal now, may, and its own overt subject.
Who is the interrogative predicand and best shot is a superlative human role, not a shooting event. Asked reports that precise question.

Inverted Had there been a breath of wind is the explicit counterfactual condition; should-have-fallen heads the modal consequence, the six mutineers contains its source-backed relative who were left aboard, slipped our cable inherits the shared modal, and away to sea is overt directional ellipsis without a fabricated went/gone. The directional shore and ungrammatical fall controls establish the selection.
The two degree fragments form successive replies and the second is an emphatic reprise of the first. Neither the missing predicate nor an antecedent is fabricated.
Can and not occupy adjacent exact subspans of cannot. They attach to answer, with He as agent and others as the object of for.
The lexical participle altered is the head event, was is its passive auxiliary, greatly is degree, and She is the patient theme.
Pause is the event-denoting complement of light made. Short measures the pause's duration rather than modifying the subject.
All is the pronominal content of knew, whereas now locates the knowing in time. I remains experiencer.
So marks the discourse transition, we is the subject of went, and on is its continuative particle.
The nominal minor reply is followed by a separate declarative-form perfect question. Woman no longer becomes the topic of forget, and the source participle forgot is retained.

Source split quotation has a real reporting clause he returned respectfully, a source vocative sir, and a resumed that-clause whose shared modal will scopes passive be seated and allow me to do this; me is agent of do under allow's control, not an argument of seated. Original and independent demonstrative positive plus passive-near-miss negative pass.
Catherine is the predicand of seemed, pleased its adjectival complement, and Lady remains her prenominal title in the selected tree.
Yes is an affirmative response. The temporal frequency almost every day quantifies day by every and approximates that universal, not an apposition.
The copular question predicates location in town of father. In remains the overt relation marker, and my is preserved as possessor.
They is the predicand and hopeless is the adjective. Of remedy is the adjective's content complement rather than a detached or missing noun.
The scalar degree almost modifies universal, and dejection is the predicand of the resulting adjective.
The overt genitive links eyes to the titled name Mrs. Bennet. Eyes remains the grammatical subject of the sparkle predicate.
Her is the addressee of called and the controlled subject of look. At has picture as object, and now modifies called rather than the infinitive.
Had is past perfect of walked, away is direction, and another part of the room is the goal with the room as the whole of the part.
The three finite predicates share Jane. Instantly modifies the motion to him, the embrace keeps its own object, and gratitude distinguishes the addressee him from its grounds goodness.

Original Wickham and perhaps form a bounded copular evaluative statement; but introduces think with modal shall like. Your husband is the comparison target, and Jane's is source-attested POSSESSIVE-ELLIPSIS with no invented husband token; equative comparison and genitive antecedent are explicit graph edges. Darcy/Mary's independent positive and non-genitive negative pass.

Vain indeed must be all her attentions is a fronted modal predicative inversion; the following vain and useless attributes govern separate coordinated nominals without supplying missing copulas. The if-clause is a finite source-backed condition, and self-destined-for-another remains an explicit adjectival complement. Independent time and coordination controls checked.

Split source quotations retain Thank you as the overt imperative formula and said Lydia as reporter. Causal for introduces anaphoric if you did; the first modal consequent is I should certainly tell you all, coordinated with then Wickham would be angry. The graph keeps condition, source reporter, two outcomes and temporal order, without inventing the action omitted after did. Lydia/Mary positive and tense contrast pass.
